description: Example hook configurations. Each entry under `examples` is a settings fragment: copy its `hooks` (or `permissions`) block into .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json. Every script referenced here exists in scripts/. See docs/hooks-cookbook.md.
usage_notes: Matchers are tool names: Bash, Edit, Write, MultiEdit, Read, Grep, Glob, mcp__<server>__<tool>. Combine with | (e.g. Edit|Write).
`if` goes on the hook handler, not the matcher group, and takes one permission rule such as Bash(git push *).
To require approval for a command, use permissions.ask rather than a hook; ask rules prompt even in auto mode.
Use .claude/settings.local.json for personal or environment-specific hooks.
Test hooks before relying on them: scripts/hooks/test-block-dangerous-bash.sh shows one way.
